name: Music Transition Design
purpose: Plan cue joins, tails, prelaps, source-to-score transitions and editorial flexibility.
scope: Bounded sound_music capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for music_transition_design.
Execute the bounded operation: Plan cue joins, tails, prelaps, source-to-score transitions and editorial flexibility.
Apply music_transition_design-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to sound_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run music_transition_design on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask music_transition_design to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
